headline: Turkey Appoints Muhsin Atcı as Capital Markets Board Chairman
summary: Tax inspection board head Muhsin Atcı was appointed chairman of Turkey's Capital Markets Board by presidential decree.
why: Regulatory leadership changes in emerging market economies can signal shifts in corporate governance oversight, financial market compliance, and enforcement policies.

impacts.name: Turkey
impacts.why: Changes in regulatory heads can impact national financial sector oversight and policy implementation.
